# পাবনা নাগরিক কমিটি (PNC Pabna)

> Citizen-driven social platform for Pabna, Bangladesh. Coordinates civic activities, events, news, and community reports.

Site: https://pncpab.lovable.app
Language: Bengali (bn-BD)

## Key pages
- [Home](https://pncpab.lovable.app/) — Overview, hero, latest activities
- [About](https://pncpab.lovable.app/about) — Mission and committee background
- [Activities](https://pncpab.lovable.app/activities) — Ongoing civic activities
- [News](https://pncpab.lovable.app/news) — Announcements and news articles
- [Events](https://pncpab.lovable.app/events) — Upcoming events with registration
- [Gallery](https://pncpab.lovable.app/gallery) — Categorized photo archive
- [Reports](https://pncpab.lovable.app/reports) — Annual reports and newsletters (PDF)
- [Constitution](https://pncpab.lovable.app/constitution) — Organization constitution and amendments
- [Membership](https://pncpab.lovable.app/membership) — Membership benefits and signup
- [Contact](https://pncpab.lovable.app/contact) — Contact information

## Machine-readable
- Sitemap: https://pncpab.lovable.app/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://pncpab.lovable.app/robots.txt
